limitations: Official rules retrieved 2026-09-10; Standard updated 2026-09-10 08:46:42 UTC. Current new-purchase 8%/5%, not legacy 10%, Pro or Zero.

Historical authoritative news/speech calendar unavailable. Evaluation does not ban routine holding but deliberate news trading is prohibited. No event-targeted rules here, but news compliance cannot be verified.

Master news restriction conservatively treats USD events as affecting crypto: -5/+5min; speeches -10min to +10min after end; >=5h prior-entry exception. Not implemented without event data; Master sensitivity is leverage-only, NOT funded compliance.

Evaluation permits weekends; current Master weekend holding temporarily prohibited since 2026-01-29 including crypto. Strategy is weekday day-only with early Friday flat, not verified session mapping.

No payout cycle selected and no payout pass claim. Biweekly 80%/14d, weekly 60%/7d generally 1% minimum; on-demand 90% requires 2% and 35% best-day consistency; new monthly 100% has 35% consistency, seven >=0.5% profitable days and 1% idea-risk striking. Conditional Master rules are not evaluation requirements.

Current 8%-target $5000 Master normally exempt from size-based idea-risk striking except monthly choice. Same instrument/direction concurrent or losing reentry within 10min is one idea. Single-position hourly entries reduce grouping; no suggestion of evasion.
No verified maximum challenge deadline. 60/120-day horizons analytical only. No $25k+ profit-concentration rule or Zero largest-loss-day rule applied to $5000 Standard.

No real FundingPips account, purchase, credentials, orders, or API integration. Owned self-developed EA evidence required; third-party EA only risk management; VPN/VPS account access prohibited and API/webhook permission unverified. GitHub Actions must never connect to a FundingPips account.
The original PAPER-001 $10000 account and frozen failing research remain independent and unchanged. Nothing from this historical research becomes live.

History has declared unavailable intervals. Primary results retain pre-gap activity and label unresolved open-gap paths indeterminate; gap-free prefix metrics are not full-period returns. Warmup restarts reduce subsequent opportunities. Complete real lower-timeframe repairs under A1 remain allowed.
